title: Independent qualification handoff for explicit head-budget normalization semantics

handoff.suggested_title: Independent Qualification of Explicit Head-Budget Normalization for the Richards Temporal Indicator

candidate_lock.B_inf_source: qualified F-SI25 bounded stiffness-aware temporal indicator
candidate_lock.H_budget_requirement: explicit finite positive external head-domain numerical/application accuracy budget in cm

required_independent_gates: Lock exact F-SI26 candidate semantics and all F-VQ28/F-VQ29 negative evidence before execution.
Independently reproduce the exact-linear theorem implication using a manufactured matrix not identical to the F-SI26 owner test matrix.
Verify dimensionless algebra, positive-budget scaling invariance and threshold equivalence C_h<=1 iff B_inf<=H_budget for valid finite inputs.
Verify invalid, zero, negative or nonfinite H_budget and invalid/unavailable B_inf fail closed/unavailable.
Use fresh or independently replayed nonlinear production-indicator values only to verify normalization/composition and noninterference; do not treat finite comparator data as truth.
Preserve bounded indicator cost and hard-mass/state/flux noninterference.
Verify O0/O2 identity where executable nonlinear production paths are exercised.
Verify no universal default H_budget, multiplier, floor, material/state coefficient, q_cap, Nmin or tail model is introduced.
Verify F-VQ28 retry nonmonotonicity remains a hard warning and is not overwritten by normalization.
Verify F-KT09 compatibility without enabling production certificate acceptance/retry in F-VQ32.

may_qualify: exact-linear error-budget implication inside the already-qualified exact-linear theorem scope
nonlinear normalized-indicator semantics without true-error upgrade
compatibility with F-KT09 generic certificate shape
must_not_qualify: any numeric H_budget value or universal temporal tolerance
bootstrap, arbitrary restart or discontinuity continuation provenance
groundwater coupling, F-GC02 or F-PE release

downstream_if_pass: Recheck live next F-KT number; F-KT11 was observed free before F-SI26 closeout but is not reserved by this handoff.
Production policy binding must remain separate from H_budget provenance/selection.
Continuation bootstrap/restart/discontinuity qualification remains a separate blocker if certificate mode must operate at those boundaries.
Resume the existing F-GC02 only after the scientific normalization and production policy/continuity dependencies are independently closed.
